title: Armstrong selected the tunes and put them on the wax
summary: Armstrong mostly chose the songs at the first session and liked to say they would put them on the wax.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Making records: studios, takes and the technology

blocks.x: Who selected the tunes? Did Louis select the tunes for that first recording session? He'd just been in town a few weeks or a few days before.
Louis. Louis did most of the selecting
of the tunes, because he would say such-and-such a name -- that's right, this is when we were recording on the wax.
And he'd always use the expression, we're going to slap it on the wax.
Yeah, we're going to put it on the wax.
So that's it. Louis would say, we're going to put such-and-such a thing on the wax.
Yeah, put it on the wax. Yeah. They don't do that waxing, now.
